Hymn 60: Battle Hymn of the Republic

This is hymn number 60 titled "Battle Hymn of the Republic" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William Steffe and the lyrics were written by Julia Ward Howe.
